name: Religion In Government
overview: Scripture teaches that government authority is established by God, and believers are called to be subject to governing powers and magistrates as part of their obedience to God. When righteous leaders govern, it brings joy to the people, but wicked rulers cause sorrow. However, obedience to government must never supersede obedience to God, as Peter and the apostles affirmed that we must obey God rather than men when the two are in conflict. Christians are also encouraged to be ready for every good work within the framework of submission to authority.
